crossRefs.note: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”
May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

translations.web: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
translations.bsb: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
translations.kjv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
translations.asv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
